```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(fivethirtyeight)

candy <- fivethirtyeight::candy_rankings


candy <- candy |> 
  mutate(
    price_pctile = pricepercent * 100,
    win_pctile   = percent_rank(winpercent) * 100,
    value_score  = win_pctile - price_pctile,
    type = case_when(
      chocolate == TRUE ~ "chocolate",
      fruity == TRUE    ~ "fruity",
      hard == TRUE      ~ "hard candy",
      TRUE              ~ "other"
    )
  )

count(candy, type)

```

# Candy Charts

## Row 1

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Candies"

list(
  icon = "basket",
  color = "info",
  value = nrow(candy))


```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Number of Fruity Candies"

list(
  icon = "basket",
  color = "secondary",
  value = sum(candy$type == "fruity"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Number of Chocolate Candies"

list(
  icon = "basket",
  color = "success",
  value = sum(candy$type == "chocolate"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Number of Hard Candies"

list(
  icon = "basket",
  color = "warning",
  value = sum(candy$type == "hard candy"))
```

## Row 2

```{r}
#| label: Best Bang For Your Buck 

BBFYB <- ggplot(data = candy, aes(x = price_pctile, y = winpercent, color = type, text = competitorname)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8, shape = 18) + 
  labs(title = "BEST BANG FOR YOUR BUCK",
       x = "Price Percentile (0 = cheapest, 100 = priciest)",
       y = "Win Percent (share of matchups won)",
       color = "Type of Candy")

ggplotly(BBFYB)

```

```{r}
#| label: dumbell plot 

top <- candy |> slice_max(value_score, n = 15)

DUMB <- ggplot(top, aes(y = reorder(competitorname, value_score))) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = price_pctile, xend = win_pctile, yend = competitorname),
               color = "grey70", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(x = price_pctile, text = paste0(competitorname, "<br>Price pctile: ", round(price_pctile))),
             color = "purple", size = 3) +
  geom_point(aes(x = win_pctile, text = paste0(competitorname, "<br>Popularity pctile: ", round(win_pctile))),
             color = "darkgreen", size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Top 15 Best Value: Price vs. Popularity Percentile",
       x = "Percentile (red = price, blue = popularity)", y = NULL)

ggplotly(DUMB, tooltip = "text")
```
